findings.summary: log-scrub tests do not wire createLogCapture into the production pino logger; they only assert on the helper, leaving acceptance bullet 8 not genuinely exercised end-to-end.
findings.suggested_fix: Build the app with an injected logger writing to createLogCapture().destination (extend buildApp to accept a logger or expose a logger factory), run real auth flows, then call capture.notContainsAny([SEED_PLAINTEXT, sessionValue, refreshValue, csrfValue]).

findings.summary: vi.hoisted env-seed block plus the lazy-getter vi.mock for db/client is duplicated verbatim across all 11 integration test files; drift risk if the env contract changes.
findings.suggested_fix: Extract a shared helper such as apps/api/test/support/setup.ts exporting `setupTestEnv()` and the db/client mock factory; import once per test file. Reduces 11 copies to one source of truth.

findings.summary: Replay-warn test asserts exactly one warn call but does not assert log level is 'warn' nor that the message field equals 'refresh.replay_detected'; weakens enriched bullet 12.
findings.suggested_fix: Augment the warnCalls[0] assertion to also check the message string (second arg or first-arg.msg) contains 'replay' so a regression that silently swaps warn for debug or rewords the message would still fail the test.

findings.summary: loginPatient helper is repeated across 6+ files with the same signature; consider hoisting to support/.
findings.suggested_fix: Add `loginAs(app, email, password?)` to apps/api/test/support/request.ts and replace the per-file copies.

findings.summary: Sad-path test 'returns non-200 when no refresh cookie is present' only asserts not 200/201 — does not check the actual expected status (422) or error code.
findings.suggested_fix: Tighten the assertion to expect(res.status).toBe(422) and expect(body.error.code).toBe('VALIDATION') so contract drift is caught.

findings.summary: Test seeds a valid JWT_SECRET via vi.hoisted so that env.ts module-scope `export const env = loadEnv()` does not throw on import — symptom of a known eager-load risk in shared/env.ts.
findings.suggested_fix: Track in retro: convert shared/env.ts to a lazy `getEnv()` or DI pattern so test files do not need a hoisted env stub to import the module under test.

findings.summary: Test re-implements seed insert logic locally (runSeed) rather than invoking apps/api/src/seed/main.ts; bullet 13 is satisfied behaviourally but a regression that breaks main.ts (side-effect script) would not be caught.
findings.suggested_fix: Refactor apps/api/src/seed/main.ts to export a pure `seedUsers(db)` function and have main() call it then pool.end(); import seedUsers in the test instead of duplicating the insert.
